reference_pressure_Pa.rationale: Standard atmosphere; ideal-gas enthalpy is pressure independent

water_heating_value_J_kg.rationale: Fully oxidised; identity reaction, not vaporization or condensation

lhv_basis.value: Registered reactant phase, CO2(g) and H2O(g) products
lhv_basis.source: SPEC §10 liquid-alcohol targets; Cantera heating-value method

thermo_data.value: Cantera species enthalpies and element weights
thermo_data.source: Smith et al. (1999), GRI-Mech 3.0 / UCSD YAML thermodynamic data; mechanisms/PROVENANCE.md

temperature_evaluation_policy.value: Evaluate species thermo at 298.15 K even if a polynomial lower bound is 300 K
temperature_evaluation_policy.rationale: SPEC standard-state LHV reference; short polynomial extrapolation is explicit, without changing the reference temperature

H2.h_fg_source: Not defined at 298.15 K: above critical temperature

CH4.h_fg_source: Not defined at 298.15 K: above critical temperature

CH3OH.density_source: CoolProp Methanol EOS: de Reuck and Craven (1993)
CH3OH.h_fg_source: NIST SRD 69 methanol standard vaporization enthalpy table

C2H5OH.density_source: CoolProp Ethanol EOS: Schroeder et al. (2014)
C2H5OH.h_fg_source: NIST SRD 69 ethanol standard vaporization enthalpy table

H2O.density_source: CoolProp Water EOS: Wagner and Pruss (2002), IAPWS-95

parameters.angles: radians internally; *_deg outputs in CAD aTDC

sources.bore_m,stroke_m,rod_m,rpm,ivc_rad,evo_ra: SPEC section 6 default test engine (WOT, IVC at BDC, EVO 140 CAD aTDC)
sources.wiebe_a,wiebe_m,combustion_efficiency,bu: SPEC section 6: Wiebe a=5, m=2; eta_c 0.98; 10-90 % duration 25 CAD*(S_L,ref/S_L)^0.5, cap 80 CAD; CA50 8 CAD aTDC (MBT proxy). Wiebe form: Heywood (1988) eq. 9.23
sources.knock_burn_fraction,retard_step_rad,reta: SPEC section 6 Livengood-Wu knock criterion and retard rule
sources.endgas_anchor_xb: Numerical: end gas is the bulk charge until x_b = 1e-3, then a frozen isentrope (standard two-zone practice); also the Woschni motored-pressure reference
sources.woschni_C,woschni_C1,woschni_C2: Woschni (1967), SAE 670931, doi:10.4271/670931; Heywood (1988) eq. 12.19; p in kPa inside the correlation only
sources.f_evap_intake,evap_end_rad: SPEC section 6 (f_evap_intake is treated as an upper bound limited by saturation; see water_model)
sources.water_T_K: 300 K liquid water, as Module 02 evaporative-cooling convention
sources.step_rad,quick_step_rad: Fixed crank step: 0.5 CAD full, 1 CAD quick; the closure error vs trapezoid quadrature reports the discretisation error
sources.equilibrium_min_T_K: Burned part frozen as complete products below 1000 K (dissociation energy there < 1e-6 of LHV); avoids needless equilibrium solves
sources.state_rtol_U,state_rtol_p: Numerical state-inversion tolerances (fraction of fuel energy; relative pressure)
sources.knock_integral_cap: Floating-point guard only; any value >= 1 is knock
sources.closure_tolerance: Task contract: |energy closure error| <= 2 % of fuel LHV
sources.otto_gamma,otto_tolerance_abs,otto_burn_: SPEC section 10 ideal-Otto check: gamma 1.4, +/-1 % abs; 1 CAD burn centred on TDC approximates an instant burn; EVO moved to BDC; R, T_IVC and heat input do not affect 1-CR^(1-gamma)
sources.no_min_xb,no_absolute_uncertainty_factor: NO integrated once x_b > 1e-3; task: absolute NO +/- factor 2
sources.plausible_efficiency_min,plausible_effic: Task plausibility band for 0-D gross indicated efficiency at w = 0 (diagnostic, not validation)
sources.limit_flame_temperature_K: Diagnostic flag only: adiabatic flame temperatures at hydrocarbon lean flammability limits are commonly quoted near 1500 K (limit flame temperature rule of thumb, e.g. Glassman, Combustion); not a SPEC selection constraint

workers.rationale: Spawned point tasks (io.ordered_map, chunksize 1); Cantera objects built inside each worker

synthetic_fallback.ignition: Douaud & Eyzat (1978) SAE 780080 form (Heywood 1988 section 9.6), RON CH4 120 / CH3OH 108.7 / C2H5OH 108.6, c = 0
synthetic_fallback.policy: quick mode only, labelled mode-quick-fallback; --full errors without Module 02 files

ignition_fit_units.value: tau = A p^-n exp(E/(R T)) (1 + c w); p in Pa, A in s*Pa**n, E in J/mol, R = 8.314 J/(mol K)
ignition_fit_units.extrapolation: Allowed for the knock integral; the fraction of the integral outside the fit's T/p/w calibration ranges is reported per point

flame_speed_fit.value: Module 02 cubic S_L(w) at 400 K, 1 atm, phi 1 (coefficients_highest_first); only the ratio S_L(0)/S_L(w) and the 0.08 m/s constraint use it
flame_speed_fit.extrapolation: None: w outside valid_w_range makes the point unavailable

energy_ledger.value: eta_c m_f LHV (x_EVO - x_IVC) = W(IVC-EVO) + Q_wall + Q_evap,cylinder + [U_s(EVO) - U_s(IVC)]
energy_ledger.closure_check: W and Q_wall re-integrated by the trapezoid rule over node states, U_s(EVO) re-evaluated by Cantera; error reported per point as fraction of m_f LHV
energy_ledger.intake_ledger: H_s,dry(T_intake) = H_s(T_IVC) + m_w,evap h_latent (isobaric mixing); closes separately (intake_closure_error_J)
energy_ledger.exhaust_term: Closed system: the charge internal-energy change replaces the steady-flow 'exhaust enthalpy change'; U_s and the EVO state are written for Module 04
energy_ledger.not_counted: Fuel combustion loss (1-eta_c) m_f LHV and the Wiebe tail after EVO leave as chemical energy; water contributes no source term

sensible_reference.value: Unburned frozen u(T) - u(298.15 K); burned u_eq(T,p) - u_complete_products(298.15 K)
sensible_reference.rationale: LHV release counts formation energy once; dissociation energy of equilibrium products is retained

mixture_model.value: Single bulk T and p; unburned frozen fresh charge + burned TP-equilibrium products mixed by mass fraction burned

residual_model.value: 5 % of the dry trapped mass as complete products of the fresh charge at T_intake (before water cooling)
residual_model.rationale: Keeps the per-cycle ledger self-contained: no residual heat or residual water is credited

water_model.value: Liquid at 300 K. Intake: isobaric adiabatic mixing evaporates min(f_evap_intake, saturation limit) with h_fg. Cylinder: remainder on the SPEC uniform schedule IVC -> -30 CAD, capped at saturation (lagged one step), then as soon as saturation allows; closed-system latent heat u_fg
water_model.source: SPEC section 6; CoolProp IAPWS-95 (Wagner & Pruss 2002) h_fg, u_fg, p_sat
water_model.deviation: SPEC says 'h_fg' for the cylinder: a closed control mass needs u_fg = h_fg - p v_fg (about 5.7 % smaller at 300 K); using h_fg there would destroy energy. f_evap_intake is an upper bound: at w > ~0.1 the intake air cannot evaporate half the water above its dew point, so the intake fraction is saturation-limited and reported (f_evap_intake_effective)
water_model.limitations: No droplet heating, spray kinetics or wall film; droplets have zero volume; liquid remaining at EVO is reported, not hidden

fuel_phase.value: Premixed fuel vapour in the charge; heat release uses the registered-phase (liquid alcohol) LHV
fuel_phase.rationale: Never credits more than LHV(liquid); the alcohol latent heat is debited from the release, so no fuel charge-cooling benefit is claimed (conservative for efficiency and knock)
fuel_phase.diagnostic: fuel_vapour_saturation_ratio_IVC > 1 means the premixed-vapour assumption is optimistic at IVC

knock_model.value: Livengood-Wu integral of 1/tau(T_u, p) from IVC to x_b = 0.9; T_u = bulk T before x_b = 1e-3, then frozen variable-cp isentrope (Cantera SP)
knock_model.limitation: Evaporation after the anchor does not cool the end gas (conservative)

burned_zone.value: T_b = max(T, min(T_flame, T_u + (T - T_u)/x_b)); T_flame = HP flame temperature of the end gas with the same eta_c*LHV release (model-consistent)
burned_zone.rationale: Two-zone NO diagnostic only; not used in the energy equation

NO_model.value: Thermal NO, extended Zeldovich, quasi-steady N, implicit integration in the burned zone; equilibrium O, O2, N2, OH, H at (T_b, p)
NO_model.source: Hanson & Salimian (1984) via Turns, An Introduction to Combustion, ch. 5
NO_model.relative_basis: mol NO per J fuel LHV relative to w = 0 at the same fuel, CR and T_intake (CA50 as used at each point); prompt and N2O-route NO and NOx after EVO excluded

gross_efficiency_boundary.value: Integral p dV from IVC to EVO divided by m_f LHV
gross_efficiency_boundary.rationale: SPEC closed cycle; no gas exchange, friction or blowdown work after EVO

cantera_ic_engine_comparison.value: ic_engine.py (Cantera examples; not downloaded per task rules): Diesel-type compression ignition, gaseous fuel injected near TDC, finite-rate chemistry, valves and moving-wall piston over open four-stroke cycles. This module: premixed SI, closed IVC-EVO, Wiebe, Woschni, water evaporation, equilibrium thermo. Different combustion mode and system boundary, so no numeric efficiency agreement is claimed; the analytic Otto check and the dry CR trend replace it
cantera_ic_engine_comparison.deviation: SPEC section 6 asks for a reproduction of the example's settings; not done (offline rule, CI vs SI mismatch)

design_point.recommendation_basis: highest gross indicated efficiency among feasible w > 0.5 points of the design fuels CH3OH/C2H5OH (CH4 is reference-only)

key_results.low_flame_temperature_note: Diagnostic, not a SPEC constraint: model-consistent end-gas flame temperature (droplet latent heat included) below 1500 K; Module 02 S_L(w) is for an all-vapour charge and may overstate flame propagation there
key_results.no_relative_uncertainty: Relative NO only; absolute NO +/- factor 2
key_results.energy_source: Fuel LHV only (eta_c m_f LHV); water has zero heating value and only absorbs latent heat

validation.cantera_ic_engine_example: documented difference only; not numerically reproduced (see assumptions)
validation.scope: In-run checks; tests/test_engine_cycle.py on the server is the unit validation
